Based in Ontario, Canada

Mohammad builds AI tools that help people make sense of complex information and make informed decisions.

At Waterloo, he explores how AI can support decisions during conversations. At Verily, he helps build healthcare AI agents whose answers can be traced back to evidence.

His work brings research, engineering, and interface design together—from an early question to a working system, and an understanding of how people use it.

I'm actively looking for Research Engineer positions in applied AI, human–computer interaction, and information visualization.
